Our Story

Where Devotion Meets Music

Mehfil-e-Sahib is a professional live Sufi and Qawwali band dedicated to preserving the timeless beauty of devotional music while creating unforgettable experiences for modern audiences.

From intimate mehfils to grand wedding celebrations and corporate events, every performance is crafted with passion, elegance, and authenticity. We don't just perform — we create an atmosphere that stays with you long after the last note fades.

Common Questions

Frequently Asked

Yes, absolutely. Mehfil-e-Sahib is available for events across all of India — from major metros to Tier-2 cities and destination wedding venues. Travel and accommodation costs are discussed transparently during booking.

We come fully equipped with professional-grade sound equipment, microphones, monitors, and mixing for most venues. For very large venues, we coordinate with your event's PA system in advance.

Absolutely. Song requests are welcome and encouraged. Share your list when you book and we will prepare arrangements that suit your event's mood and duration perfectly.

For weddings and large events, we recommend booking at least 2–3 months in advance, especially during peak season (October–February). For corporate or private events, 3–4 weeks is usually sufficient.

Packages vary by event type, duration, number of artists, and location. We provide transparent custom quotes after understanding your needs. Contact us or use our WhatsApp for a quick estimate.
